name: Severe Congenital Neutropenia (Kostmann Syndrome)

criteria.description: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) consistently below 500 cells/µL
Recurrent severe bacterial infections starting in infancy
Bone marrow examination showing maturation arrest at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage
Identification of pathogenic mutations in ELANE or related genes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of profound neutropenia (ANC <500/µL), recurrent severe bacterial infections from infancy, and bone marrow maturation arrest
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recurrent severe bacterial infections in infancy
Bone marrow maturation arrest at promyelocyte/myelocyte stage

rare.notes: Occurs as progression to myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia

laboratory: Bone marrow biopsy showing maturation arrest at promyelocyte/myelocyte stage
imaging: Chest X-ray showing pneumonia or lung abscesses
genetic: Mutations in HAX1, G6PC3, or other related genes
other: Recurrent severe bacterial infections starting in infancy
Poor response to conventional antibiotic therapy without neutrophil recovery

distinguishingFeatures: Periodic oscillations in neutrophil counts every 21 days
Dysplastic changes in multiple cell lines
Often transient or associated with other autoimmune diseases

redFlags: Profound neutropenia with ANC <500 cells/µL persisting beyond neonatal period
Recurrent severe bacterial infections including sepsis and pneumonia
Failure to thrive or delayed growth in infancy
references: Dale DC, Bolyard AA, Aprikyan AA, et al. Severe congenital neutropenia: clinical features, molecular pathogenesis, and treatment. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2003;2003(1):36-45.
Horwitz MS, Corey SJ, Grimes HL, et al. Severe congenital neutropenia. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2007:58-64.
Beck DB, Ferrer G, Sikora KA, et al. ELANE mutations in severe congenital neutropenia and cyclic neutropenia. Blood. 2017;130(10):1122-1131.
